evals.name: full-deck-humanization
evals.prompt: 把這份 12 頁資安簡報去 AI 味，保留事實，封面圖、情境圖和示意圖也一起重做，最後要可編輯 PPTX。
evals.expected_output: 先做逐頁診斷與風格鎖定，再生成有用途且一致的素材，最後 handoff 至 PPTX 製作並做全份 QA。
expectations: Diagnoses the whole deck before redesign
Hands off to editable PPTX production

evals.name: precise-infographic-boundary
evals.prompt: The slides look AI-generated. Redesign them and make a visual showing our exact 37%, 42%, and 21% incident shares.
evals.expected_output: 精確數據圖必須用圖表或原生形狀製作，不交給圖像模型生成文字與數字。
expectations: Uses deterministic charting for exact values

evals.name: audit-only-no-mutation
evals.prompt: 先看這份簡報哪裡像 AI，只要診斷，不要改檔也不要製圖。
evals.expected_output: 只交付具頁碼的診斷與設計方向，不修改檔案、不生成圖片。
expectations: Does not mutate files or generate assets

evals.name: neighbor-pptx-maker
evals.prompt: 逐頁內容和所有圖片都核定了，請照公司模板組成可編輯 PPTX，不要改設計。
evals.expected_output: 應由 pptx-maker 處理，不啟動視覺自然化。

evals.name: neighbor-single-image
evals.prompt: 這不是簡報任務，請單獨幫我生成一張可以傳到 LINE 群組的父親節祝賀圖片，不需要投影片、版面診斷或 PPTX。
evals.expected_output: 應使用一般圖像生成流程完成獨立賀圖，不啟動簡報自然化、逐頁診斷或投影片製作。
expectations: Does not trigger for a standalone image request

evals.name: english-template-redesign
evals.prompt: This cybersecurity deck feels like a generic AI template: every slide has three cards and glossy neon illustrations. Keep the approved claims, redesign the visual system, and replace only the images that do not help comprehension.
evals.expected_output: Audits the deck as a system, preserves approved claims, establishes a restrained art direction, and replaces only nonfunctional visuals without forcing every slide into the same layout.
